summary: Borr Drilling filed a 6-K disclosing definitive agreements to divest its 51% equity interest in Mexican JVs Perfomex I and II to its long-standing local partner. Consideration equals the estimated net book value of Borr's equity interest as of July 31, 2026, with no per-share price or premium disclosed. The partner becomes sole owner and operator of rigs Galar, Gersemi and Njord, while Borr retains rig ownership and participates via bareboat charters on largely unchanged economics. Close expected September 2026, subject to customary conditions; watch for contract continuity with PEMEX, transition execution and any value leakage.
